checks.localUnique_sing_proof: Read in full (l.1189–1667). The core follows B21 prop:isom_strong at α = β = 0 (BTZ_1.tex:468–475) by the interface's own route, without invariance of domain. (1) The box {r < ε₁, |t − t₀| < ε₂} is, in log-polar coordinates, the convex, angle-shift-invariant e0Box; mathlib's IsCoveringMapOn.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts lifts F through isCoveringMapOn_orbitMk_cylPos. (2) GX's exists_smul_eq_on_of_isLocalHomeomorphOn gives D∘L = g∘D on the whole box. (3) Uniqueness of lifts makes τ (one turn) a deck shift k, and IsRigidAction.smul_eq_of_eqOn on the open range of D∘σ gives gP = P^k g. (4) conj_ne_zero and map_line_of_conj show that g preserves ℝu; isAxisAff_of_mem then gives λ > 0, with the sign derived from time orientation. btzConj is an explicit cylinder homeomorphism, continuous at the apex because only r and t are needed there. (5) btzConj_winding applies the IVT to the angle: |k| ≥ 2 yields two points of reg U in distinct Γ-orbits with the same image, which contradicts InjOn, so k·k = 1. (6) btzE0Descend (Γ-equivariance both ways, using k·k = 1) and e0Lift_mem (chart translation by g at each regular point) give e ∈ G with source = range inr = connectedComponent y₀. Globalisation uses e0_eqOn_of_eqOn_open on U ∩ reg, which is preconnected by isPortly_reg.locallyConnectedIn. No hypothesis carries the conclusion, and the hypotheses are satisfiable: btzE0_exists_notMem_reg is an axis point.

summary: Round 2 audit of WP-41c: clean. The file builds with no warnings, has 0 real sorry, and every theorem is axiom-clean (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). Round 1's major is resolved. localUnique_sing (B21 prop:isom_strong at α = β = 0) is now proved in full, without invariance of domain, by the interface's route: covering lift, Liouville, deck relation gP = P^k g, an axis-preserving g in null coordinates, the IVT on the angle forcing k = ±1 from injectivity, and descent to an automorphism of E₀ in G, globalised by rigidity. Elaborating a Causal.CBG.LocalModel.{0} with the file's theorems confirms that every closed field (rigid, localUnique_sing, localUnique_reg, regularChart, sing_mem, isOpen_regY, dense_regY, t2Y, closedUnderRestriction, locallyConnected) has the field's exact type. localUnique_sing_adherent and typeAgreement are honestly partial: verbatim Props over a causality C, with sorry-free reductions whose hypotheses are exactly the reported obligations (b1) and (b2). Those hypotheses are neither circular nor vacuous, and both look true for E₀. The round-1 minors (status, the SCOPE (b) direction, the rigid-reuse note) are all addressed. No name clashes, no ledger-label marks (correct, labels: []), the DEC-33 gate holds, and REPORT.json is accurate and complete. Three minors remain: the causal fields' 'causality not yet built' rationale is out of date now that WP-41e's GX.E0.causalityYBTZ exists on the same carrier, the docstring has no `>` quote of the cited lemmas, and the explicit Isom(E₀) form is not exported.
